name: quay
description: quay: a provider-agnostic task board. Bundles the quay MCP server (Core `quay mcp`, aggregating whichever Provider is enabled in the target workspace's .quay/config.yml), the quay-native author/execute authoring skills, a workspace-portable quay-directive skill (auto-detects this workspace's task store — no experiments/ dir required), and a persistent runner-agnostic loop-driver skill (select-execute-gate-done/needs-human-repeat; stops on .quay/.loop-stop sentinel).
